body:
P2-25 DESIGN for N-34 (design PR #96, helper-n34): the ONE place where survives_fold_whole is described, and three sentences to keep in your design so the two texts say the same. Information, not a command: the lead and the advisor decide, and the lead said to tell him if a change is needed on #96's branch.

THE RULE lives in the P2-25 design (docs/tasks/P2-songs-as-references.md, P2-25 part 4; PR #98). textnorm.survives_fold_whole(text) is DEFINED by P2-25 SLICE 1 (small, moves no server caller, merges alone). **N-34 slice 1 imports it and cannot start before P2-25 slice 1 has merged.** Era 0 (until P2-25 slice 2): after NFKD every letter and digit that is not a combining mark is ASCII. Era 1 (from slice 2): true for any text with a letter or a digit. Call it on the lead artist, the title and, when compared, the album. NOT 'the key is empty': fairuz|habibi| (a Latin artist, two different Arabic titles that start alike) and |habibi| (two artists, one Latin title) are not empty and are wrong.

THREE SENTENCES TO KEEP IN PR #96 (they replace the sentences that restate the rule):
(a) section N-34, 'depends on P2-25', point (2): 'Every slice that merges before P2-25 slice 2 carries the skip rule: it calls textnorm.survives_fold_whole, which P2-25 slice 1 defines (so N-34 slice 1 cannot start before it has merged), on the artist, the title and, when compared, the album; the rule and its era-0 form are described once, in the P2-25 design, part 4.'
(b) the step 0 row of the table: 'The artist and the title must pass textnorm.survives_fold_whole (described once, in the P2-25 design, part 4: do not restate it here), the folded strings are non-empty, and a length is known. Otherwise: unsupported / no_length, not remembered.'
(c) the refile bullet 'refile says no, whoever calls it': 'refile calls survives_fold_whole (never a copy of it), refuses a ref that is on the P2-25 worklist (refs.recheck_pending, from P2-25 slice 3: its files may belong to other songs until the rehome has judged them), and carries its own test row.' (Your text says refile 'carries its own copy of the rule': that is the line that disagrees.)

ALSO: the rehome of P2-25 only RE-POINTS song_file rows; it never renames, moves, retags or deletes a file. Only a keeper file under Encore/ may be moved, and only by your refile. A moved file is a new music-server id and the rehome does not clash with it. The order (P2-25 before N-34) is yours to keep in order.json; PR #98 touches order.json only to append N-36 and N-37 to later.
